modulation_entries.hypothesis: DPP-4 inhibition by saxagliptin raises active GLP-1/GIP levels, enhancing glucose-stimulated insulin secretion and suppressing glucagon, thereby amplifying the glucose-lowering biology of metformin beyond metformin alone
